subject.title: Feature: supported pre-prompt tool allowlist hook for plugins

question: Should OpenClaw add a stable plugin-SDK hook for per-request tool selection at the shared post-policy, pre-prompt boundary, or keep dynamic model-visible tool routing operator-config-only for now?
rationale: The request adds a compatibility-sensitive plugin API that affects every agent runtime's model-visible tool surface; maintainers must choose the permanent contract and its safety semantics before implementation.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow SDK hook
options.body: Define a single post-policy selector that returns validated stable tool IDs, is fail-open on plugin faults, and is covered across every supported agent invocation path.

options.title: Keep static policy only
options.body: Retain existing tools.allow/tools.deny and profiles as the supported way to control model-visible tools, without promising per-request plugin routing.

options.title: Prototype behind an internal seam
options.body: Validate runtime coverage and telemetry with an internal experiment before committing a public plugin API contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow SDK hook
recommendation.body: Define a single post-policy selector that returns validated stable tool IDs, is fail-open on plugin faults, and is covered across every supported agent invocation path.

likelyOwner.reason: The request is centered on the typed plugin-hook contract and its runtime execution semantics, where Kaspre has recent current-main maintenance history.
